sourceOccurrences.label: Galton–Watson extinction and critical estimates
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source exposition with explicit correction cases
sourceOccurrences.note: Includes the deterministic critical exception (N-ERR-03) and periodic-support caveat (N-ERR-04). N9P5 gives the varying-law survival asymptotic under uniformly integrable squared offspring; DGVA adds the joint positive-field transform limit under the same moment control, allowing means on either side.

sourceOccurrences.label: Near-critical survival in an offspring-thinning family
sourceOccurrences.note: A fixed finite-second-moment potential offspring law is independently thinned; the proof does not claim uniform expansions for arbitrary varying offspring distributions.

sourceOccurrences.label: Population on survival at a critical generation
sourceOccurrences.locator: Chapter 2, branching-process and binary-tree discussion; Chapter 3, lines 750–794
sourceOccurrences.note: AYHV proves Yaglom’s exponential limit and conditional uniform integrability. It concerns generation population rather than total progeny, and needs no aperiodicity or third-moment hypothesis.

proofUses.reason: Root decomposition and the critical fixed-point criterion, with the uniform generating-function expansion proved in N9P5; the new comparison permits either sign of the mean displacement.
The finite-variance generating-function recursion and the survival asymptotic give the conditional Laplace limit; exact generation means supply uniform integrability.
